subject: Scaling test schedule & handoff — Streamline onboarding
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Margaret Chen <margaret@streamline.ai>, Amit Rao <amit@streamline.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Scaling test schedule & handoff — Streamline onboarding

Hi Margaret / Amit —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our onboarding plan, we'd like to run the formal scaling and acceptance tests next week to validate latency and throughput for OpenAI-style traffic patterns you expect in production. Below is a proposed schedule and the handoff checklist so your SREs and our inference team can coordinate.

High-level acceptance targets (agreed during discovery):
- P50 inference latency: <= 120ms
- P95 inference latency: <= 240ms
- Sustained throughput target: 350 QPS (80-token average payload)
- Peak burst handling: 600 QPS for up to 2 minutes without error-rate > 1%

Proposed test windows (all times PST):
- Dry run / smoke: Wed 2027-09-15 09:00–10:00
- Full throughput ramp: Thu 2027-09-16 09:00–12:00
- Soak & regression checks: Thu 2027-09-16 13:00–16:00

Attachments: streamline-load-plan-v1.xlsx (load schedule + traffic profiles), runbook-ops-instructions.pdf (what to watch & rollback triggers).

Please confirm the schedule and your preferred incident channel (pager / Slack) for the actual test run. Also flag any production IP allowlist or rate-limit ACLs we need to prepare.

Next steps after you confirm:
1) We’ll share a Datadog dashboard link and create a temporary read-only API key for your team.
2) Monica will run a pre-check with your SREs for network/egress and model variant pinning.
3) Rafael will run the workload generator and coordinate live metrics.

Thanks — looking forward to the execution.

—
Irene Choi
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0183

Redwood Inference

From: Margaret Chen <margaret@streamline.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit@streamline.ai>, ops@streamline.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scaling test schedule & handoff — Streamline onboarding

Thanks, Irene. Schedule looks reasonable — we can commit to the windows on Thu the 16th for the ramp and soak. Quick notes from our side:

- Our SREs prefer Slack for the run (channel #streamline-redwood-tests) and Ops will monitor via ops@streamline.ai as backup.
- We have an internal rate-limiter that will reject sustained > 500 QPS without a manual exception. Can Redwood coordinate a short exception for the 600 QPS bursts so we can exercise peak handling?
- We will only allow traffic from the following egress ranges during the test: 54.215.0.0/16, 35.192.0.0/12 (we'll provide a formal allowlist doc by EOD).

Two asks before the dry run:
1) Can you confirm which model variant you'll use for the test (exact model string)? We want inference parity with the variant we'll run in prod.
2) Please share the post-test evidence template so we can sign off against the acceptance criteria.

I'll loop in Amit for the allowlist and we'll confirm the Slack channel.

—
Margaret Chen
SRE Lead, Streamline AI
margaret@streamline.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Margaret Chen <margaret@streamline.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scaling test schedule & handoff — Streamline onboarding

Hi Margaret —

Thanks for the quick reply. Short answers:
- Model variant for the run: redwood/redwood-13B-q4_0 (we'll pin that exact artifact and provide the model hash in the drive link).
- We can request a temporary exception for the 600 QPS burst for the test window. Rafael — can you run the burst within the first 20 minutes of the ramp so we capture cold-path behavior?

Operational checklist (pre-dry run):
- Streamline to provide IP allowlist + confirm egress by EOD 9/15.
- Both sides to verify time sync and NTP drift < 2s.
- Datadog dashboard: read-only key will be uploaded to Drive + shared to Margaret.
- Post-test evidence: sample template attached (post-test-evidence-template.csv).

We’ll run the dry run tomorrow morning at 9:00 PST to validate connectivity and config. If that passes, full ramp on Thu. Rafael / Vivek will be in the channel to tune batching and concurrency.

—
Monica Patel
Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: ops@streamline.ai, Margaret Chen <margaret@streamline.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 08:58:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scaling test schedule & handoff — Streamline onboarding

Forwarding the final runbook and the small-run command list we'll execute in the dry run.

Attachment highlights: runbook-ops-instructions.pdf — includes rollback triggers (error-rate >1.5% OR p95 > 400ms), and the exact k6 scripts we'll run.

Planned dry-run steps (09:00 PST):
1) Smoke: authentication + single-request latency checks (5 min)
2) 10-minute steady at 50 QPS to exercise KV cache warm-up
3) short ramp to 200 QPS (5 min) then stop; collect traces

Full ramp (Thu 09:00 PST):
- 0–10m: ramp 0 -> 100 QPS
- 10–30m: ramp 100 -> 350 QPS
- 30–40m: 600 QPS burst (2 minutes), then back to 350 QPS
- 40–180m: sustain 350 QPS soak

Live observability knobs we’ll monitor: token-level latencies, GPU utilization per shard, per-node queue lengths, and application error rate. If you want additional traces correlated to session IDs, send sample session IDs before 08:50 PST.

I’ll post the Datadog URL to the Slack channel when we start.

—
Rafael Mendes
Performance Engineer, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai

From: Margaret Chen <margaret@streamline.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Amit Rao <amit@streamline.ai>, ops@streamline.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scaling test schedule & handoff — Streamline onboarding

Update from today's run: great coordination — dry run and full ramp completed. Observations and next steps:

Summary of results (preliminary):
- P50: 98ms (pass)
- P95: 210ms (pass)
- Sustained 350 QPS: error-rate 0.4% (pass)
- 600 QPS burst (2 minutes): error-rate 1.3% (within rollback threshold but above the 1.0% acceptance target)

Action items:
- Streamline will review internal rate-limiter behavior and confirm whether a production exception for bursts is acceptable. (Assigned: Amit)
- Redwood to share the final post-test evidence CSV populated with raw metrics and model hash. (Assigned: Irene / Rafael)
- Follow-up checkpoint: Mon 2027-09-20 10:00 PST to agree on final acceptance or next remediation steps.

Thanks to the Redwood team for the quick responses — Rafael, your Datadog link was super helpful for immediate triage. If you can upload the filled post-test-evidence-template.csv and the model artifact hash to the shared drive, we'll start our internal sign-off runbook.

—
Margaret Chen
SRE Lead, Streamline AI
